notes.title: Em-A-Li 2
notes.notes:
Em-A-Li is getting a bit popular and I had already planned to continue on the series but stopped because of how little the community was. The community is now bigger thanks to a big youtuber so I've decided to continue on the development and think about the story of Em-A-Li 2 as well as finishing off Em-A-Zurvival Part 2.

It'll be a long wait before the actual development starts due to a game I'm currently working on now called, Harvest Island. But I'll notify you who [url=https://yobobgames.com/em-a-li-email/]joins my email list[/url] that the game will be in development.

notes.title: Updated voice acting
notes.notes:
-Andrews voice acting has gotten an upgrade as well as the writing but the main story hasn't changed.
-Changes to some cut scenes to improve Andrews voice acting.
-Added a save spot near the receptionist to ease players from rage quitting the game because of instant game overs.

notes.title: Game Balancing
notes.notes:
After hearing some feedback, I've increased the player's vision by 50% Hopefully this doesn't change the horror feeling too much. 

What does this mean? It means that you can play the game without having to resort to your flashlight. I've added a few images for you to see how much of a difference it made with an increase in vision.
